Canonical style taxonomy is stored in style_taxonomy; style is the broad whiskey type, substyle is reserved for meaningful nested subtypes, geography is stored in place/subplace, and age/finish/attributes are structured separately. Group counts use every tasted whiskey; group averages and style percentiles use qualified whiskeys with n>=3. ABV is stored for each rated whiskey; batch-, barrel-, vintage-, or market-dependent expressions use a representative/typical ABV to keep the site display compact.
